# Sidebar Component Documentation

## Overview
This is a modern, dark-themed sidebar navigation component (Claude Code interface) with a hierarchical structure combining main navigation, dynamic sections, and recent items.

---

## 1. Sections

### **Header Section**
- **Logo/Brand**: "Claude Code" with icon
- **Action Icons**: Chat icon and Code icon (top-right)

### **Primary Navigation Section**
Menu items with icons:
- **New** (with "+" icon) - Primary action button
- **Projects** (with folder icon) - With "New" badge indicator
- **Artifacts** (with artifact icon)
- **Customize** (with settings icon)
- **More** (collapsible, with chevron icon)

### **Secondary Section - Recents**
- **Section Header**: "Recents" label with settings icon
- **Recent Items**: List with orange dot indicators
  - v1.3 demo site checkout
  - Wiki generation in API

### **Footer Section**
- **User Profile**: Shows "c" avatar, "codx · Pro" text
- **Action Icons**: Theme toggle and search icons

---

## 2. Functionalities

| Feature | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| **Navigation Items** | Click to navigate/change views |
| **New Button** | Primary CTA (likely opens creation dialog) |
| **Badge System** | Shows status/notification (e.g., "New" badge on Projects) |
| **Collapsible Sections** | "More" uses chevron to expand/collapse |
| **Recents List** | Dynamic list of recent items with quick access |
| **Settings Icon** | Opens sidebar preferences (top-right of Recents header) |
| **Profile Section** | Click to access user menu/settings |
| **Search/Theme Toggle** | Bottom icons for utilities |

---

## 3. Styles & Design System

### **Color Palette**
- **Background**: Dark (#1a1a1a or similar)
- **Text**: Light gray/white (#f0f0f0, #999999)
- **Accent**: Blue (badge/highlights)
- **Indicator Dots**: Orange/yellow (#FFA500)
- **Hover States**: Slightly lighter gray background

### **Typography**
- **Main Font**: Sans-serif (likely Inter, SF Pro Display, or Segoe UI)
- **Header**: Larger, bold weight (app title)
- **Items**: Medium weight, regular size
- **Secondary Text**: Smaller, muted gray

### **Spacing & Layout**
- **Sidebar Width**: ~300-350px
- **Item Padding**: 12-16px horizontal, 10-14px vertical
- **Item Height**: ~44-48px
- **Gap Between Sections**: 24-32px
- **Icon Size**: 20-24px

### **Interactive States**
- **Hover**: Light background highlight (#2a2a2a)
- **Active**: Brighter background or left border accent
- **Disabled**: Reduced opacity

### **Icons**
- **Style**: Outline/line icons (2px stroke)
- **Library**: Likely Feather Icons, Heroicons, or custom SVGs
- **Size**: 20-24px

---

## 4. Vue.js Implementation Structure

### **Component Architecture**
```
Sidebar (Main Container)
├── Header
│   ├── Logo/Brand
│   └── Action Icons
├── Navigation Section
│   ├── NavItem (New)
│   ├── NavItem (Projects)
│   │   └── Badge
│   ├── NavItem (Artifacts)
│   ├── NavItem (Customize)
│   └── Collapsible NavItem (More)
├── Recents Section
│   ├── Section Header + Settings Icon
│   └── RecentItem List
│       └── RecentItem (each)
└── Footer
    ├── Profile Section
    └── Action Icons
```

### **Key Props & Data**
```javascript
data() {
  return {
    navItems: [
      { id: 1, label: 'New', icon: 'plus', action: 'new' },
      { id: 2, label: 'Projects', icon: 'folder', badge: 'New' },
      { id: 3, label: 'Artifacts', icon: 'artifact' },
      { id: 4, label: 'Customize', icon: 'settings' },
      { id: 5, label: 'More', icon: 'chevron', expandable: true }
    ],
    recents: [
      { id: 1, name: 'v1.3 demo site checkout' },
      { id: 2, name: 'Wiki generation in API' }
    ],
    moreExpanded: false,
    activeItem: null
  }
}
```

### **Key Methods**
- `handleNavClick(item)` - Navigate/action handling
- `toggleMore()` - Expand/collapse "More" section
- `toggleSettings()` - Sidebar settings
- `selectRecent(item)` - Recent item selection
- `openUserMenu()` - Profile actions

---

## 5. Important Implementation Notes

✅ **Responsive Design**: Consider mobile collapse to icon-only mode
✅ **Accessibility**: Proper ARIA labels, keyboard navigation
✅ **Dark Mode**: Native support (already dark-themed)
✅ **State Management**: Track active item for visual feedback
✅ **Dynamic Content**: Recents should update in real-time
✅ **Smooth Transitions**: Hover effects and expand/collapse animations
✅ **Icon System**: Use consistent icon library across component

---
